One battery cycle refers to the use (discharging) of an amount that is equal to 100% of the battery capacity. (A cycle can add up at different intervals due to discharging and charging at different battery levels, for example, using up 60% of the battery on one day, then recharging fully and using 40% the next day. When the two add up to 100%, this is considered to be one battery cycle.)
Accumulated battery cycle information currently used
When a new device is purchased, it will record the initial date when the user first utilized the device and the replacement date when the battery is replaced at the service center.

This value represents the maximum capacity level (%) available for full charge relative to the rated capacity.
Estimated state of health of battery

• Software integrity can't be guaranteed

Haka kuma, akwai rumbun bayanai da ba a gani a cikin fayil na Hoto da Fayil domin bin dokar da Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) ta tsara. Dokar C2PA's na da ƙudurin rage yawan bayanan ƙarya da ake samu a kan intanet ta hanyar tantance tushen bayani, tarihin gyare-gyarensa, da kuma sa hannu na duk wani Kayayyaki da aka yi amfani da shi na gyara."

Keɓantawa, tsaro, da sarrafa mai amfani su ne ainihin siffofin Ingantacciyar basirar Galaxy AI. Koyaushe kuna da cikakken iko akan lokacin da ake amfani da Ingantacciyar basira na Galaxy AI da kuma yadda suke sarrafa bayananku.

"Duk bayanan da aka yi amfani da su don horar ingantacciyar basira na ci gaba sun fito ne daga tushen ɗabi'a. Ba a yi amfani da bayanan sirri ko na sirri don wannan horon, kuma muna samun izini daga masu haƙƙin mallaka kafin amfani da duk wani abu mai haƙƙin mallaka."

Siffofin ingantacciyar basira suna aiki ne kawai lokacin da kuka ba su izini ta danna maɓallin ko kunna su a cikin Saituna. Siffofin ingantacciyar basira ba su taɓa samun damar shiga bayananku ta atomatik ko allon bangon sikirin ba tare da izinin ku ba.

Don samar da mafi kyaun yanayi, muna aiki da kamfanonin abokin hulɗa da ke manyan jagora a duniya don fasahar da aka samar. Kamar mu, abokan hulɗanmu ba sa taɓa amfani da bayananka don koyar da mashin ko don saita tallace-tallace.
Siffofin ingantacciyar basira sun haɗa da tsaro don tabbatar da ƙunshiyar da aka samar bai ƙunshi komai ba da zai iya zama mai cutarwa ko bai kamata ba.
